data.name: Grand Escape: LISAO
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to LISAO Grand Escape: LISAO is a linear, story-driven 3D action game heavily fueled by violence, dark humor, and relentless brawls. Step into the shoes of Casey Jhinson and embark on a bloody and breathtaking journey to escape LISAO prison.

Alliances and Betrayals Surviving LISAO isn't just about throwing punches. Casey must forge unlikely alliances with other inmates to navigate the facility's treacherous cell blocks and yards. Use these connections to push forward, but in a place like this, trust is a dangerous game.

Key Features:

  • Linear Storytelling: A focused, cinematic narrative from start to finish. Experience Casey's desperate escape without filler content or getting lost.

  • Brutal Combat: Use your fists and whatever it takes to survive intense, close-quarters combat when words fail and deals fall apart.

  • Prison Hustle: Complete tasks, gather items, and engage in interactive mini-games—from washing dishes to secretly dismantling your cell toilet.

  • Stealth & Traversal: When fighting isn't an option, use cover to sneak past patrols, crawl through tight spaces, and navigate the facility undetected.

  • Retro Aesthetic: Immerse yourself in a gritty, dark atmosphere brought to life with nostalgic low-poly 3D models and retro style textures.

Unapologetic Tone: A mature experience filled with dark humor, heavy profanity, and the raw, uncensored reality of prison life.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Dört çekirdekli Intel Core i5 veya AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 veya AMD Radeon RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains mature content that may not be appropriate for all ages. Players will experience scenes of violence and physical combat. The narrative and dialogue frequently include heavy profanity, dark humor, sexual jokes, and implied sexual content. Additionally, the game features depictions and references to drug use and inappropriate behavior throughout the gameplay.
